name: @gipity/i18n

scripts.test: bash -c 'for t in tests/*.test.js; do node $t || exit 1; done'

description: Multi-language for any Gipity web app: a language picker, locale persistence, RTL, and plural/translation lookup. On install it scaffolds src/js/strings.js and wires `@gipity/i18n`; move your user-facing copy into strings.js and read it with `t('key')`. Translations live in translations.js.
